title: Felix′s Survival Modpack
description: This modpack tranforms Minecraft into a super hardcore game.
body:
This modpack is designed for players who know vanilla Minecraft well and want a fresh, more challenging experience without trying to reinvent Minecraft.

It expands survival, exploration and immersion and fixes some common gripes I and many others have with the vanilla game with carefully chosen mods that make the world feel harsher, more alive, and more adventurous while keeping the gameplay intuitive and recognizable. No overwhelming mechanics or spawning in with a hotbar full of books ;)
